summary: The Sway v2 (docs/main_story.md section 11, 11.9-11.10; SwayCaster, scripts/sway): the timed lock-on, its motes, mastery by use and the moves of the vertical slice (the wreck's first lock and Breath's Gust). Every move one keeps is a spell: it is cast ONLY when readied (the hotbar's selected spell, SwayCaster.ready_spell); a weapon's aim never locks. The other moves of the table (Draw, Flare, Mark, Kindle, Smother, Lighten, Pin, Beacon) come with Acts 2-4. Form (the fifth art: Earth Wall, Stone Form, Pillar, Mend) is the stone-shapers' circle-work. Gust also lifts and hurls stones (stone: the owner folded Levitate into Gust, 2026-10-02).
_doc: free_use (the user, 2026-10-03: "lets make the spells free use right now"; SwayCaster.free_use): true, every spell is known in every game from the start (the level installs the caster: SwayCaster.install_free; the Tab screen's Spells list has them all, none put on the hotbar or readied) and costs no motes (casts, Gust's holds, the Form spells; an overstrain loses none; the belt hidden). The story's grants are still kept (saved) for when it is false again: false brings back the gating (a spell only once granted: the story's sway_grant, give=) and the motes' costs. Everything else (the lock, its times and ranges, the hands, mastery, modes, breaks) is the same either way.

lock: grace_s the aim may be off the target before the lock breaks (it flickers meanwhile and does not fill); release_s the time after a full lock to let go and cast (held longer it fizzles, the motes kept); cone_deg the grace cone round the crosshair that still counts as on a target already locked (design 11.8: 2 deg); moving_mps above this body speed the move's moving_mult slows the fill (you can walk while locking; running is slower).

motes: belt_max on Earth (3 under our sky; 6 in the Drift, 10 with upgrades: later), start the belt at install, floor_max and floor_s the free floor (the tinderbox coal breathes one back every floor_s seconds while the belt holds fewer than floor_max).

one_hand_weapons: what the right hand may hold while an EXPERT casts with the left palm alone (a weapon key: the pistol, the tomahawk; or a tool in the hand: the saber). Untrained and practised casts want both hands empty.

arts: each art's colour (the ring, the thread) and ring shape for colour-blind players (design 11.4: Breath open, Light dotted, Ember notched, Weight doubled). 'keel' is the wreck's borrowed fire (the first lock): not an art you keep.

moves: art; label (the hotbar's name); lock_s; motes (cost); range_m; targets (kinds it locks on: fighter = NpcFighter, animal = WildAnimal, prop = a RigidBody3D, fire = a lit torch, campfire or a piece still catching, scripted = a node in group sway_targets, sail = a node in group sway_sails, stone = a stone Gust lifts: GustLift.is_stone); named_only: it locks only on a target whose meta sway_move names it; needs_grant false: usable without SwayCaster.grant and without a readied spell on a target that names it (a scripted lock, not a move you keep: the wreck's first lock); far_stretch the lock's stretch at the end of its range (design: up to 1.5x); moving_mult; push (gust: m/s given to people, animals, props; up_mps; heavy_kg above which a prop takes less; snuff_m fires blown out round the point); sail (gust held on a sail: the lock held keeps the wind in it, a mote every drain_s seconds after the first; SwayCaster.sail_wind); stone (gust locked on a stone, GustLift: a raised spike or cannonball, a node in group sway_boulders or with meta sway_stone, a small rock: a RigidBody3D whose meta surface is stone or rock; a crate is a prop, pushed. Its own range_m and lock_s; heavier than mass_kg it needs two casters, the hint heavy. At full lock it tears free (hold.tear_s) and rises hold.rise_m while the aim is held, its draw filling over draw_s like a bowstring (Bow.draw_time); held past strain_start_s the strain builds (the stone shakes, the aim trembles) to break_s, where the power breaks: it drops, the caster staggers, the motes are lost. Let go: it is hurled along the aim (hurl.<kind>: mps [none drawn, full draw], gravity m/s2, damage [min, max] through Hit.deliver, pierce: through people like a lance (spike), roll: rolls on landing (cannonball), mass_kg)); lift (first_lock: up_m, aside_m, s, the target then let fall); modes (a spell's modes, the first its default: the mode key flips them, SwayCaster.flip_mode) and mode_labels; mode_moving_mult and mode_range_m a mode's own moving_mult and range_m; mastery_uses overrides mastery.uses for the move; ai_factor is data for later (AI casters at 1.3x the player's time).

mastery (docs/main_story.md 11.10; SwayCaster.tier): each spell grows by use (casts landed, counted per spell and saved with the motes). uses: the casts to reach each tier (untrained, practised, expert); lock_mult each tier's lock time; clips the cast each tier plays (SwayPose, animations_extra/Frontier_Form.res): untrained both hands empty and the floor cast (own-form-clap-press: clap, squat, palms to the ground; own-form-press-wall on an upright) for every spell including Gust; practised both hands empty, a two-handed standing push (own-sway-push-two); expert one palm (the left) pushes, the right hand may hold one of one_hand_weapons (own-sway-push-one, played without the right arm).
sfx: Sfx ids played when they exist (none fit the rising tone: SwayTone makes a soft one).

form (the fifth art, the stone-shapers' circle-work: FormCast, FormEffects; the user 2026-10-02): the lock is a circle drawn on the ground at the target (FormCircle) instead of the ring round the crosshair (ring 'ground'). The matter comes from the place: earth raised leaves a hollow where it came from; mending takes wood from the pack. readied_only: it locks only once readied (every spell does in v2). targets: ground (the earth under the crosshair: a fixed body, not a built floor, not steep; a person or a thing hit stands for the ground under it), built (a built piece alight or charred, a fire's ruin, a raised wall worn by shot), circle_m the circle's radius; range_m is measured flat from the feet. wall: width_m, height_m, thick_m, ahead_m (from the circle's middle away from the caster), rise_s, life_s, hits (musket hits of at least hit_min damage before it crumbles), crumble_s. stone_form throws itself (the user, 2026-10-03, after the spike then Gust proved hard: "Stone Form throws itself": one spell, one aim; FormEffects.stone_form, its Throw): the lock's circle at the aimed point as before (the edge of the reach when aimed past it); cast, the stone of the mode bursts up out of the ground throw.ahead_m in front of the caster toward the aim (its hollow there), rises to throw.chest_m over their feet in throw.rise_s (a spike turning its point to the crosshair), then flies at the crosshair's point at that moment (not the circle: on a man, at the man; far along the ray at the sky), aimed a little high for its drop, by GustLift's flight with throw.hurl.<mode> (mps [none drawn, full draw: the same], gravity, damage through Hit.deliver, pierce, roll; tremble_deg its scatter): mode spike (height_m, radius_m) a lance, fast and flat, through people, sticking where it meets the world; mode cannonball (radius_m, about 0.5 m across, mass_kg) heavier on a little arc, knocking people aside, rolling on. A thing in the physics it meets is knocked on throw.knock_mps.<mode> (and struck when it takes hits). Either lies life_s after (a stone for Gust to lift and hurl) and sinks in sink_s. (The spike's hit_r, damage, people_mps, up_mps, animal_mps, down_s, shards, shard_m are the burst's at the circle, FormSpikes: unused while it throws itself.) pillar: modes self (rises under the caster; cast while running, practised and up (untrained, the floor cast holds the caster still), launch: run_mps, up_mps, fwd_mps, carry of the run's speed, rise_s, height_m, and a boost x boost when let go within plant_window_s before a foot plant or plant_after_s after one (the step cycle: Footsteps' strides; each plant heard as the step and shown as a beat in the ring while it locks); cast mid-air it catches them: air.rise_s fast, under where they will be by then, its top at their feet less air.gap_m, air.min_m..air.max_m tall (the user, 2026-10-03: "the pillar should match the height so if im jumping and cast a pillar underneath me it should quickly make a pillar just as big to catch me")) and free (at the aimed circle, out to mode_range_m.free: anywhere near, the owner's free mode); radius_m, height_m, rise_s (it carries whoever stands on it), life_s, under_m, hits, hit_min, crumble_s. hollow: the dark pit decal's width_m (across the caster's line) and depth_m (along it), fade_s. mend: each stage back costs wood.per_stage of the first of wood.kinds in the pack (a ruin stood up again costs wood.ruin): a ruin stands again charred, a piece alight is put out, a charred one made whole; a raised wall worn by shot is packed again (no wood). form_sfx: Sfx ids for the clap, the press, the rise, its rumble, a crumble, a spike, the mend, the crackle, and, for Gust's stones (GustLift), the tear, a hurl, a stone's strike and the break (played when they exist); tree (a tree drawn into a wall), splinter (a wooden wall going).

matter (the user, 2026-10-03: "it should be earth wall where if the terrain is mud its a mud wall if its a tree i can make a tree wall you know"; FormMatter, scripts/sway/form_matter.gd): the Earth Wall, the Pillar and Stone Form's stones take their matter from where they are raised. form_ground: the rules, in order: the collider's meta surface named in surfaces (the terrain's GroundStone outcrops, a boulder) or a group in groups (the vegetation's rocks) -> its matter; snow lying at least snow_m (m, SnowCover.depth_at) -> snow; the terrain's splat rock at least rock_min -> stone, mud at least mud_min -> mud (the brook's bed, the river's banks and bed, the woods' wet hollows); the square's type in squares (the marsh) -> its matter; else earth. Earth Wall's targets have tree: the crosshair's ray on a standing tree's trunk within the reach locks the tree (its circle round the trunk's foot): a wall of its wood (matter wood) stands just past its stump (tree.gap_m clear of it) and the tree goes into it (out of the forest as felling takes it, a stump left, saved as a felled tree). earth_wall.wall.materials: each matter's label (the HUD's spell line, the lock's line), surface (the wall's meta surface: Sfx impacts), the wall's numbers over the wall's own (width_m, height_m, thick_m, hits, hit_min, crumble_s; log_r the palisade's logs), crumble (dust, slump: sags and spreads, rubble: stones tumble out, snow, splinters: leans back), circle (the lock circle's colour, drawn 0.7 of the way from the art's), mended (mend's line), shape (bump: how lumpy, batter_m: wider at the foot, top_m: how ragged the top, sag_m: mud's slump, round_m: how far down its top rounds over, fresh: how freshly broken the top), look (the procedural surface, shaders/sway/form_matter.gdshader: kind rock / earth / mud / snow / wood, colours a b c d fresh foot, foot_h, scale, rough, bump, wet, stones, top_k). pillar.pillar.materials: a pillar's strength by matter (its look the wall's). stone_form.looks: the look of a stone raised from each ground (the user: "we need to work on the textures").

gust.label: Gust

lock_rules._doc: Gust's own, easier than the art's lock rules (the user, 2026-10-03, 'gust its hard and unenjoyable', chose 'easier Gust everywhere'): a wider aim zone (it also catches a target near the crosshair, not only under it), a longer grace, no fizzle (release_s 0: let go whenever after the click)

gust._raised: Gust on a raised wall or pillar tears a ball of its matter out where the aim is on it and hurls it along the aim through the wall (FormEffects.gust_chunk; the user, 2026-10-04: 'use gust to push certain parts of the rock wall and pillar'); the wall takes a hit for it (its hits_max: it crumbles).

elements._doc: Each element's keys (skills_r2 spec 2.1-2.2, the owner's answers of 2026-10-05): 1 STRIKE, 2 PUSH (its first move grows if held: grow), 3 DASH, 4 WALL, 5 HEAL. A key is [id] (one move, or one move whose two variations are the key's two moves) or [id, id] (two moves of one variation each). A tap readies the key's first move, a second tap within guard_rules.double_tap_s the other; nothing is remembered. Fire's 4 holds Fire Wall and Breath (the owner kept Breath), fire's 1 grows too (Punch held: the Fireball). Bending.keys; the jab on the left button and the guard on E are their own blocks (jabs, guards). A move's 'modes' are only what the ring offers; specs of variations it no longer offers stay under 'bend' for whoever still casts them. The open world's Form spells keep theirs in 'world_modes' and 'world_mode_labels' (Stone Form's disc, the earth wall's column and shell, the pillar's free and ramp: SwayCaster.world_modes_of), and the pillar's footfall boost stays the open world's (the ring's Lift reads sink_s and run_mult instead).

guards._doc: Each element's guard on E (input bend_guard; no readying): [move, variation]. Bending.guard. A short lock, then it stands its window_s; a hit in its first guard_rules.perfect_s is perfect (yours), later half gets through (late_mult) except earth catching stone (always a full catch, held: E again throws it back). The spec's takes (what it guards), handles (one other kind, fully only on the beat), return (hold, swing, straight, bounce).

jabs._doc: Each element's jab on the left button (the quick spell's default; Q puts the readied move there instead, Q held guard_rules.quick_reset_s brings the jab back): [move, variation], every one within 10 m. Fire's is Embers (the owner kept it). Bending.jab; MatchSetup.quick_of.

passives._doc: One passive per element (spec 2.4), its line shown at the element's pick. Bending.passive.

earth.label: Rooted
earth.line: Stand still: your locks fill faster and you're pushed less.

water.label: Flowing
water.line: Your water curves toward where you look for a moment after it leaves.

fire.label: Footwork
fire.line: Your locks fill at full speed while you move.

air.label: Carried wind
air.line: Hit straight out of a dash and you knock harder.

guard_rules._doc: The guard's and the lock's shared numbers (spec 2.3, 2.5, 2.6, 8.1). hold_drop_s 0: a caught stone is held until thrown, as before (owner question 6b).

stones._doc: Loose stones on the deck (spec 2.10): at most loose_max a player (a new one sinks his oldest); Shove takes a loose one only within shove_loose_m of the caster.

air_rules._doc: Round 3's cast layer in the % ring (smash_r3 spec §0, §4.4, §6, §8; AIR; BendR3 reads it, every key with its safe default there). Only while RingRules.stock_on() (or, per body, RingMoves.of(body) != null): the open world, the duel and the classic ring never read it. key3_min_s: 3 on the deck goes no sooner than this after its press (a second tap inside it is the travel move). guard: the held guard's longest stand and how soon a cast key drops it. A move is 'out' from its release to its strike + out_after_s (the Slam's slam_out_after_s), a Strike (key 1) at least strike_out_min_s; landing while out plants land_lag[class] (x land_lag_hit_mult after a hit; lag_class names the key-1 moves' classes, every jab and air hit 'jab', key 2's second moves and a deck key-2 lock let go in the air 'key2'). jab_step_s: after a jab that hits, the next jab is ready this long after the last one left the hand; jab_string_gap_s: a jab hit later than this after the last one starts a new string; jab_strike_max_s: a jab whose lock the step shortened leaves the hand no later than this after the release (its pose's strike not waited for longer: the step's 0.15 s is the string's beat). pop: the third jab that hits in a string (its set knock, its set stun, its tag; earth's stone kept in the hand and its throw with E). wall_lip_clear_m: walls stand at least this far inside every lip. floor_wave_lip_over_m: the Kick's wave runs this far past the lip. air_stone_reach_m: earth's stones in the air tear from a deck face this near. fire_wall: its entry pop (once a body each entry_every_s). deck_inset_m: Column and Geyser rise at least this far inside the lip (never from the tank's water).
